task: Evolve exact-head visual fidelity evidence into the canonical VX Visual Diff Intelligence Core: verify evidence checksum, source identity and Page Schema fingerprint, then derive deterministic per-viewport drift diagnostics without moving screenshot comparison or mutation authority into the Builder.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Exact-head Template Factory browser proof already captures per-template/page/viewport visual evidence with source commit, page fingerprint, case fingerprint, RERUN/REUSED provenance, browser diagnostics and golden global/local diff semantics. VX currently has no reusable authoring intelligence that can consume that evidence safely. The new Core must reason over verified evidence without treating screenshots as Runtime truth, without duplicating pixel comparison, and without accepting stale evidence after Page Schema or shared-runtime changes.
observableOutcomes: A shared canonical Page Schema fingerprint helper reproduces the existing quality route SHA-256 fingerprint semantics over canonical JSON.
Visual Diff Intelligence accepts the existing shoporation.template-factory-quality-evidence.v2 envelope rather than creating a second screenshot-evidence format.
Manifest checksum is recomputed and must match before any visual conclusion is emitted.
Evidence source commit must match the caller-declared exact source commit; HEAD, missing or mismatched identities fail closed.
Current Page Schema fingerprint must match the case pageFingerprint for every viewport evidence item.
REUSED evidence is accepted only with explicit fingerprint-equivalent reuse proof; stale or unverifiable reuse fails closed.
Per-viewport state is classified deterministically as exact-match, bounded-drift, blocking-drift or no-baseline from existing golden global/local semantics and case errors.
A page-level matrix summary requires desktop/tablet/mobile evidence and exposes evidence-backed issues suitable for later Publish Readiness.
The Core performs no screenshot capture, pixel comparison, filesystem access, persistence, publish or Builder mutation.
VX-VISUAL-DIFF-INTELLIGENCE becomes PROVEN only after executable adversarial proof; Publish Readiness, Smart Intent and Smart Auto-Fix remain non-PROVEN.
unresolvedRisks: A stale screenshot may look plausible after Page Schema or shared Runtime changed and could be misreported as current.
A valid global mismatch ratio could hide a failing local hotspot if local golden semantics are ignored.
REUSED proof could be accepted without its fingerprint-equivalence chain.
A missing golden baseline could be misreported as exact visual match.
Case errors unrelated to golden diff could be discarded, overstating readiness.
The Builder could accidentally gain pixelmatch/filesystem dependencies and create a second visual truth engine.
Different canonical JSON implementations could make Page Schema fingerprints silently incompatible.

in: Shared SHA-256 canonical Page Schema fingerprint helper compatible with existing quality-route semantics.
Typed validation of existing Template Factory visual evidence envelope and per-case provenance.
Exact source-commit and Page Schema fingerprint binding.
Golden global/local diff reasoning and browser-case error/warning preservation.
Desktop/Tablet/Mobile page-matrix summary suitable as downstream diagnostic evidence.
out: Screenshot capture or pixel comparison inside the Builder.
Builder UI adoption in this change set.
Persistence, database, publish or Page Schema mutation.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Visual evidence can become dangerously stale while still looking authoritative. Highest practical assurance requires cryptographic manifest/page identity, exact source binding, strict reuse provenance, global plus local golden interpretation, canonical three-viewport completeness and zero mutation authority.

acceptanceCriteria: Canonical Page Schema fingerprint output matches Node SHA-256 over the exact quality-route canonical payload.
Invalid manifest contract, incomplete evidence, missing checksum, checksum mismatch or non-exact source identity fail closed.
No case may be used when template key/version/page type or pageFingerprint differs from the current document.
REUSED cases require reuseProof.fingerprintEquivalent=true and matching previous/current fingerprint chain.
Golden status pass with zero mismatch yields exact-match; pass with positive mismatch yields bounded-drift; fail or dimension-mismatch yields blocking-drift; missing yields no-baseline.
A failing local golden result cannot be downgraded by a passing global ratio.
Existing case errors remain blocking evidence and warnings remain visible diagnostics.
Page summary requires exactly one canonical case for each desktop/tablet/mobile viewport; duplicates or missing viewports fail closed.
Intelligence source imports no Playwright, pixelmatch, pngjs, node filesystem, persistence or publish authority.
VX-VISUAL-DIFF-INTELLIGENCE becomes PROVEN while VX-PUBLISH-READINESS, VX-SMART-INTENT and VX-SMART-AUTOFIX stay non-PROVEN.
invariants: Screenshots and golden baselines remain external quality evidence, never Runtime or Page Schema truth.
The existing Template Factory evidence contract remains the source evidence envelope.
Current document identity and exact source identity are mandatory before visual reasoning.
No visual diagnostic mutates Page Schema or promotes a golden baseline.
UNKNOWN, missing, stale or unverifiable evidence is never PASS.
Local and global golden semantics are both authoritative inputs to drift classification.

failureModes: Manifest checksum is stale after evidence fields change.
Evidence comes from another commit but the screenshot appears visually similar.
Case belongs to another template version or page type.
Current Page Schema changed after proof but source commit metadata was copied forward.
REUSED case lacks a valid fingerprint-equivalence chain.
Global mismatch passes while local concentrated mismatch fails.
No golden exists and intelligence reports no drift instead of unproven.
One viewport is missing but page-level summary still claims visual coverage.
edgeCases: Zero mismatched pixels with valid baseline.
Positive mismatch below global threshold with local pass.
Golden baseline missing on an otherwise valid browser case.
RERUN and REUSED cases mixed across three viewports.
Warnings only, with no errors and bounded drift.
Duplicate viewport evidence for the same page.
Evidence checksum valid but source commit mismatched.

alternatives.summary: Consume and verify existing exact-head Template Factory evidence, then derive deterministic Builder-facing diagnostics.
alternatives.reason: Reuses the existing visual proof authority and prevents a second screenshot truth engine.

alternatives.summary: Run screenshots and pixel comparison directly from the Builder.
alternatives.reason: Would duplicate quality infrastructure, add browser/filesystem dependencies and blur Runtime versus evidence authority.

alternatives.summary: Trust only golden mismatchRatio without provenance or local semantics.
alternatives.reason: Would accept stale evidence and could miss concentrated local regressions.

specialistReviews.finding: Template Factory quality evidence already contains the required page/viewport and golden provenance.
specialistReviews.resolution: Build a consumer/reasoner over the existing evidence envelope; do not modify screenshot authority.

specialistReviews.finding: Screenshot evidence must not become a Runtime dependency or render truth.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep the intelligence pure and evidence-only; no renderer, screenshot or persistence imports.

specialistReviews.finding: Source commit alone cannot bind proof to an unsaved/current Page Schema.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require both exact source identity and SHA-256 Page Schema fingerprint equality.

specialistReviews.finding: Global mismatch thresholds are insufficient because local hotspot semantics already exist.
specialistReviews.resolution: Visual Diff Intelligence must preserve both global and local pass/fail semantics from the evidence case.

challenge.scenario: Evidence checksum is changed or omitted.
challenge.finding: Untrusted payload could forge pass state.
challenge.resolution: Recompute SHA-256 canonical manifest checksum and fail closed.

challenge.scenario: Manifest is valid but sourceCommit differs from the caller-declared exact source.
challenge.finding: Old shared Runtime proof could be reused.
challenge.resolution: Classify evidence stale and reject page intelligence.

challenge.scenario: Page Schema changed while template/version/pageType stayed identical.
challenge.finding: Visual proof no longer represents current content/layout.
challenge.resolution: Recompute current Page Schema fingerprint and require equality.

challenge.scenario: Global mismatch ratio is below threshold but local hotspot fails.
challenge.finding: Ratio-only reasoning would hide concentrated regression.
challenge.resolution: Blocking drift if either globalPassed=false or local.passed=false.

challenge.finding: Absence could be mistaken for zero drift.

challenge.scenario: REUSED case is carried from an older proof without reuseProof.
challenge.resolution: Reject reused case unless fingerprint-equivalent proof is explicit and coherent.

challenge.scenario: Only Desktop and Mobile cases exist.
challenge.finding: Page summary could overclaim responsive coverage.
challenge.resolution: Canonical matrix requires desktop/tablet/mobile exactly once each.

challenge.scenario: A developer tries to add Playwright/pixelmatch or mutation calls to the intelligence Core.
challenge.finding: A second visual authority would emerge.
challenge.resolution: Source-level negative proof forbids those dependencies and Page Schema mutation APIs.

proofPlan: Fingerprint compatibility proof against Node createHash SHA-256 canonical payload.
RERUN and valid REUSED provenance proof plus invalid reuse rejection.
Exact-match, bounded-drift, global-fail, local-fail, dimension-mismatch and no-baseline classification matrix.
Canonical three-viewport completeness and duplicate-case fail-closed proof.
Maturity proof promotes only VX-VISUAL-DIFF-INTELLIGENCE; downstream VX blockers remain non-PROVEN.
Normal CI + exact-head Template Factory Quality Gate v2 + Completion Truth + lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: Visual Diff Intelligence accepts only checksum-valid exact-source Template Factory evidence bound to the current Page Schema fingerprint.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Stale, wrong-page or checksum-invalid visual evidence cannot be reported current.

requirements.requirement: Golden global/local semantics and case diagnostics produce deterministic fail-closed per-viewport and three-viewport drift intelligence.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Visual Diff Intelligence cannot create a second screenshot/pixel or Page Schema mutation authority.

requirements.requirement: Visual Diff Intelligence completion does not promote Publish Readiness, Smart Intent or Smart Auto-Fix.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Visual diff completion cannot imply downstream VX capabilities are proven.

notes: Ninth Brabus hardening wave. Factory Genome, Type System, Constraint Planner, Media Planner, deterministic lineage, anti-clone, Dynamic Production Compiler and VX Inheritance Intelligence Core are PROVEN and lifecycle-closed. Remaining dependency order: Visual Diff Intelligence → Publish Readiness → Smart Intent → Smart Auto-Fix. Builder-facing Inheritance UI adoption remains a separate change set and is not claimed by this wave. Template #3 remains forbidden.
